from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-be01b177.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    colors = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != sep)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for rows in row_groups:
        row = []
        for cols in col_groups:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != sep for r in rows for c in cols)
            row.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
demo=grid
print(transform(demo))
